overview:
**Fire danger across the Montrose (High Elevation) area is Moderate today, driven by dry 1000-hour fuels even as recent rain keeps flames in check.**
- Danger stays mostly Moderate through Sept. 29, dipping to Low tomorrow before ERC climbs toward 60% by the weekend.
- Light east winds (7 mph) and a chance of showers/thunderstorms today and Thursday should limit fire spread; no Red Flag Warning is in effect.
- 0 of 7 local watchout thresholds are currently met.
- Ouray County rescinded Stage 2 restrictions and dropped to Stage 1 on Sept. 3, and all fire restrictions in unincorporated Ouray County were rescinded effective Sept. 18, 2026; BLM's Uncompahgre Field Office restrictions cover Montrose, San Miguel, Ouray, Delta, and part of Gunnison County.
- Nearby: the Elk Fire has burned 7,257 acres with 52% containment as of late August near Lake City on the Hinsdale/Gunnison line, with today's data showing 73% containment and full containment estimated Oct. 31.
